title: January 2027 cohort registration is open
author: Tripple A
summary: The next 3-month mentorship runs from beginner to advanced and opens on 11 January 2027.
body:
Registration for the January 2027 cohort is open. The programme lasts three months and moves from beginner foundations to advanced Law and Order execution.

Plans start from 120 USD, with a custom price when a student needs a different arrangement. Choose online or in person when you register. Online sessions run on Zoom and Google Meet. The in-person venue is sent to enrolled students.

title: What to prepare before the first week
author: Tripple A
summary: A short preparation list for new students: time, a notebook, and a platform login. No profit target is required.
body:
Before January, set aside a weekly study block you can keep. Bring a notebook or a simple journal, and make sure you can log in to the charting platform you already use.

You do not need a track record to join. Beginners start with terminology, charts, and risk basics. The goal of preparation is attendance and honesty in your journal, not a promised return.

title: A routine beats a prediction
author: Tripple A
summary: Educational note on why the mentorship teaches a session routine before it teaches a setup.
body:
Law and Order separates two jobs. Law is the rule you agreed to follow before the session starts. Order is the limit on size, the stop in the plan, and the decision to stand aside when the rule is not there.

This note is teaching, not a forecast. It is not a view on where a pair will trade tomorrow, and it is not a signal.

title: Online and physical sessions use the same curriculum
author: Tripple A
summary: Students pick a preferred mode. Recordings, Discord, and weekly reviews support both groups.
body:
Every taught session is marked Online / Physical. Online live sessions run on Zoom and Google Meet. In-person students use the cohort room, and that venue is sent after registration.

Recorded lessons, the Discord community, and weekly reviews support both modes. If you need a different mix, use Request a custom price and describe it.

title: How the three months are divided
author: Tripple A
summary: Month 1 is foundations, Month 2 is process, Month 3 is Law and Order execution and a written plan.
body:
Month 1 covers forex basics, terminology, platforms, candlesticks, and risk basics. Month 2 covers technical analysis, structure, entries and exits, risk management, and trading psychology.

Month 3 applies the Law and Order framework compiled by Grand Mentor Abdiwali Moalimuu: execution, journaling, live sessions, and a written trading plan. The full rule set is taught inside the mentorship.

title: This feed will stay educational
author: Tripple A
summary: Market posts on this site explain context and risk. They will not publish buy or sell calls.
body:
Forex News items will summarise themes a student might study, such as session times or scheduled data, once that workflow is confirmed.

They will not tell you to buy or sell. Forex and CFD trading can lead to the loss of your capital. Past examples used in class do not predict the next result.

title: Journaling is part of the advanced month
author: Tripple A
summary: Students record the rule they used, the risk they took, and whether they followed the plan.
body:
A useful journal entry names the rule, the risk, and whether you followed it. It does not need a screenshot of a winning trade to be valid.

Weekly reviews look at that record with you. The point is a repeatable process you can describe in writing.

title: Markets in the teaching scope
author: Tripple A
summary: The programme teaches forex majors, gold, and indices. Product details will be confirmed in class.
body:
Lessons refer to major currency pairs, gold (XAU/USD), and indices as the markets students practise reading. Which symbols are used in a given week depends on the lesson plan.

Nothing on this site is an invitation to trade a specific product. Choose products you understand, and only with money you can afford to lose.
